subject: Compositor health advisory — interagent.safety-quotient.dev returning 500 on discovery endpoints

observation.description: The interagent.safety-quotient.dev compositor returns HTTP 500 on two discovery endpoints. The operations-agent domain serves its agent card normally (200 OK).

diagnosis.root_cause: loadAgentRegistry() in worker.js (line ~1532) runs before endpoint routing. Both failing endpoints depend on the registry result. agent-card.json returns static AGENT_CARD before loadAgentRegistry() executes, so it remains unaffected.
likely_failure_modes: KV binding (AUTH_KV) unavailable or quota exceeded — loadAgentRegistry reads/writes KV cache for agent cards
Cascading fetch timeouts — all 5 peer agent card URLs timing out (5s timeout) with empty/expired KV cache
Unhandled exception in loadAgentRegistry() propagating to top-level handler

body.request: Before starting the v1 UX pass, please check: (1) whether you deployed any Worker changes recently that might affect KV bindings, (2) whether peer agent card URLs resolve from Cloudflare's edge. If you have wrangler access, `wrangler tail` on the interagent Worker will show the actual exception.
body.mitigation_note: Operations-agent can redeploy the Worker if needed. The fix likely involves wrapping loadAgentRegistry() in a try-catch at the top-level handler so discovery endpoints degrade gracefully rather than 500.

action_gate.gate_condition: Identify actual exception from Worker logs before applying fix

epistemic_flags: Diagnosis based on static code analysis — actual exception visible only in Cloudflare Worker logs (wrangler tail or dashboard)
